roles.advisor: verdicts — review, adjudication, second opinion; top-tier models only

effort_policy.rule: no stored default — pick per task from its difficulty, never below floor; pass it with the cell's effort_syntax

fallback_route.rule: not a cell, not a normal candidate — reaches the same model on another wallet when the primary pool is exhausted or the carrier is down

quota_pools.codex: ChatGPT Plus/Pro subscription (pi OAuth, provider openai-codex)
quota_pools.anthropic: Claude subscription (same pool as the host)

cells.effort_syntax: baked into the model name (-low/-high/-xhigh/-max), or --model 'id[effort=high]'; no medium tier — the floor lands on -high
cells.notes: model names rotate — re-run --list-models before dispatch
one pi cell per provider pool — pick the cell by wallet, not by CLI; `pi auth check --provider openai-codex --json` must be ready

advisor.note: rung ②③ passed; write path unprobed

cells.notes: same pool as the host — no quota saving; used for a clean second context and as the chain floor; export PROMPT_FORGE=0 before launch

executor.note: lighter work first — cheaper on the shared pool
